headline: THE
SUCKER
IS YOU.

scenes.say: If you can't spot the sucker at the table within half an hour, it's you.
Information asymmetry: one side knows something the other doesn't.
The one who knows more prices things right, picks the good games, and skips the bad ones.
The one who knows less doesn't just lose hands. They don't know which game they're in.
It's true in poker, in used cars, in every deal someone pitches you.
Before you join any game, ask who knows more than you, and what they gain from it.

takeaway: Before you join any game, ask who knows more than you, and what they gain from it.
